parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human sodium channel protein type 9 subunit alpha (CHEMBL4296). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical SMILES. Join docs to require at least one PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Filter by target CHEMBL4296 and standard_type IC50. Require canonical_smiles to be present and require pubmed_id or doi to be present. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
